title: Better MC [FORGE] - BMC4
description: Version 1.20.1 | A Proper Vanilla+ Modpack | Don't play Vanilla play this!
author: SHXRKIE
body:
![In purple text and white text, "BETTER MINECRAFT" is displayed infront of a screenshot of the Minecraft Overworld. The background image has a tree with purple leaves on both sides.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc76c836ab354e79660c2f5d81a13a87396a2f38.jpeg)

![In all-caps bold text, the word "FEATURES". ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/785d3640a720d7e56cba3a6e2bbcdc37f34cf7e1.png)

✔️ Full parity with [Curseforge Version](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/better-mc-forge-bmc4)

✔️ 100+ Quests

✔️ Completely Overhauled World Generation ([Biomes o' Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty), [Geophilic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/geophilic))

✔️ Fully Optimized with Shader Support

✔️ Overhauled Stronghold & Fortresses

✔️ New Bosses and Mobs ([Mowzie's Mobs](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mowzies-mobs), [Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm))

✔️ Thousands of NEW Dungeons & Structures ([When Dungeons Arise](https://modrinth.com/mod/when-dungeons-arise), [AdoraBuild: Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/adorabuild-structures))

✔️ The Aether Dimension with Many Tweaks and Additions ([Deep Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/deep-aether), [Aether Redux](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-aether-redux), [Aether Villages](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether-villages))

✔️ QoL Features such as [Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones) and [ XP Tomes](https://modrinth.com/mod/xp-tome)

✔️ [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) with Additional Features

✔️ [Rideable Dragons](https://modrinth.com/mod/dragon-mounts-legacy/)

✔️ Many Custom Features for an Improved Experience

✔️ Built-in, [Free World Sharing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tLTC6wYcWVM)

✔️ [270+ Mods](https://www.modpackindex.com/modpack/64026/better-mc-forge-bmc4)

versions.name: Better MC [FORGE] - BMC4 v40
versions.changelog:
**\[Stability Update]**
In this update, we have updated the Simple Storage Network mod to the latest version. This version of the mod has a bug that prevents hoppers from working with storage networks in some cases, but also fixes several crashes and other small bugs. After careful consideration, we decided that the hopper bug is less urgent than the game crashing issues. If you would like to continue using hoppers in your storage network, you are free to downgrade the Simple Storage Network mod to version 1.11.3

**Mod Changes**
* Added DnT Ancient City Overhaul (by Nova_Wostra)
* Added Mining Speed Tooltips (by Txni)
* Added Misc Tweaks (by pajic)
* Added Aether Addon Emissivity (by TheAetherTeam)
* Removed Inventory Management (Deleted from Curseforge)
* Updated 34 mods

**Config Changes**
* Fixed all Dragon Egg quests completing when one dragon egg was obtained
* Set Leaf Culling to Solid mode to improve appearance of leaves
* Regenerated the ModernFix structure cache to fix a rare crash and improve chunk generation speeds
* Unbound the JEI Select Search Bar keybind as it caused issues while typing
* Re-enabled Quark inventory sort buttons

**Updates**
* Enchanted books from BetterNether and Spawners+ will now have unique textures (Beautiful Enchanted Books)
* Boulders now have smaller hitboxes while travelling to avoid unwanted collision with terrain (Mowzie's Mobs)

**Fixes**
* Crash when opening inventories (Polymorph)
* Particles turning black while items are being picked up (Mowzie's Mobs)
* Crash when adding the Travelers Backpacks mod to the modpack manually (AllTheLeaks)
* Twisting Ivy and Helixes are now properly orientated (Jaden's Nether Expansion)

## [Quality of Life Update]

versions.name: Better MC [FORGE] - BMC4 v28
versions.changelog:
[Copied from CF changelog]

**[Visuals Update]**

**Mods:**
+ Added Yung Structures Addon for Loot Integrations (by someaddon)
- Removed Endless Biomes (Caused many crashes and massive lag)
 
**Configs:**
- Added a quest for the Season Calendar
- Set the default render distance y-stretch to 400%. Feel free to lower this value in Video Settings for better performance.
- Heavily customized the default enabled config for the Euphoria Patches shaderpack so it works with the new colored lighting, alongside some other tweaks for a better experience.
- Increased the spawn rate of end cities by 150%. Keep in mind that end cities are unable to spawn on many modded blocks and are more common in vanilla biomes.
- VanilAA shaders are no longer enabled by default, as it caused issues for people on lower end GPUs. If you have a decent GPU then these shaders should still be fully compatible, and you will see much better graphics quality with it enabled and may even gain FPS.
 
**Updates:**
- Added 6 new structures (Philip's Ruins)
- Added a cooldown to Umvuthi's hurt animation to prevent him from getting stuck (Mowzies Mobs)
- Zooming now works when in third-person and will overall be a lot smoother (Just Zoom)
- Added Advanced Colored Lighting and Colored Light Fog, which allows for beautiful colored lighting to be created by light sources (Complementary Shaders)
- Added Carved Bases, which are a decorative block for the bottom of the walls in the bronze dungeon (Aether Redux)
- Added a new light block, the Runelight, which can be turned on/off with a right-click (Aether Redux)
- Added unique sky colors to some biomes (Aether Redux)
- Decreased the spawn rate of nagas (Mowzies Mobs)
- Entities hit by a torch or flint and steel will be set on fire (Amendments)
 
The following updates are specifically for when the Euphoria Patches shaderpack is enabled in Video Settings:
- Added custom properties to many modded blocks. The End and Nether dimensions are especially affected by this.
